contractSummary.originSetting: ASPM_JIRA_API_ORIGINS, JSON array of at most 16 unique canonical HTTPS origins. Unset/empty string/[] add nothing; malformed/null/wrong types/duplicates/oversize/noncanonical inputs fail field-specific private preflight.
contractSummary.networkBoundary: Configured Slack origin union explicit Jira origins only. Preserve caller-narrower DialContext. Both Environment and Run must admit the full set without an accidental inner Slack-only gate. No unwrapping, unrestricted replacement client, automatic Atlassian/Slack fallback or permission/target selection.
contractSummary.programmaticProbes: Environment is the normal entry. Reflection only probes JiraAPIOrigins []string for invalid programmatic inputs and nonmutation, so the new tests do not depend on missing production fields at compile time.
contractSummary.preserved: Normal TLS/hostname verification >=1.2, bounded explicit CA, no proxy/cookies/ambient credentials/redirect following, bounded cancellation, DB/key-only health role, exact accepted backend approvals and terminal semantics.
contractSummary.safeFailures: The exact bounded classification alternatives were written in CONTRACT before tests: failed/unavailable/metadata, blocked/scope/metadata, blocked/unavailable/metadata, or pre-adapter blocked/native-client-unavailable with empty stage, all HTTP 0. Redirect is blocked/scope/metadata/307. No receipt/create marker/retry/native-field fabrication. Positive caller-dial/TLS witnesses additionally apply.

observerDesign.reuse: Unmodified newHarness, newFixture, freshTLS, newJira, API/session/intake/preview/queue helpers, native ADF assertions and accepted app backend. No new fake application, replacement handler, RoundTripper success fake, worker constructor or business SQL seed.
observerDesign.native: Loopback byte-forwarding observers terminate TLS only at the unchanged owned native fixture. They retain counts, not HTTP bodies or credentials. Unknown and redirect sockets must be zero; an untrusted TLS socket must positively be observed with zero HTTP.
observerDesign.sql: The actual service/main database URL points through a bounded byte-for-byte relay to the selected authenticated PG15432. Existing pgproto3 decodes client frames only for Query/Execute counts and claim-progress booleans. Counts share the fixture's existing 1400-operation counter. No fabricated PG replies, SQL rewrites, raw packet/SQL/bind logging, role changes or extra dependency.
observerDesign.progress: Three further forwarded eligible-claim executions, with a live entrypoint and single worker pool, are required instead of sleeping and assuming no retry. No forever/exactly-once/all-unobserved-attempts claim.
observerDesign.childIdentity: Only the new runner's separately built cmd/delivery-worker.exe is launched, its SHA256 is checked, and each owned PID/start interval is recorded. The old TestMain worker-child flag is not supplied. The newly compiled test harness is not the delivery command.
observerDesign.cleanup: Context/PID-owned cleanup only, no process-name kills. The runner can clean an orphaned actual-main PID only after matching the unique invocation binary path/hash and start interval; forced or refused cleanup cannot silently produce a successful overall receipt.
observerDesign.sqlPlaintextRequirement: Already explicit local fixture sslmode=disable only. If this or the observer framing is unsupported during Sol calibration, report the blocker and obtain an Astra-authored correction. Do not bypass counting or weaken a frozen helper.
